section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains how charity scattered among the nations, through our service in exile, accumulates to hasten the physical redemption.
section.t: And this is the matter of charity etc. that was scattered among the nations,
that through our deeds and service during the time of exile
(in the three lines of Torah, service, and acts of kindness, and particularly in the spreading of the wellsprings outward)
behold, in addition to that which each and every day
behold, each and every action among the aforementioned combines into a great account of charity
so that then "Jerusalem will dwell as unwalled cities" also physically,
with the coming of Moshiach our righteous one,
